words.sense: comparison explains a relationship through a shared structure
misconceptions: Thinking any figurative image necessarily explains a structural parallel.

words.sense: figurative description calls one thing another
misconceptions: Assuming an explanatory comparison is only an imaginative identification.

semantic_axes.description: An analogy compares how two different things work to explain an idea; a metaphor describes one thing as another to create meaning or an image.

edges.boundary_rule: An analogy compares how two different things work to explain an idea; a metaphor describes one thing as another to create meaning or an image.
clues_a: parallel processes mapped step by step
clues_b: one thing is named as another
figurative image rather than mapped reasoning

misconceptions.M1: Confuses analogy with metaphor by overlooking the defining difference: An analogy compares how two different things work to explain an idea; a metaphor describes one thing as another to create meaning or an image.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes evidence for metaphor necessarily proves analogy; these are different tests.
misconceptions.M3: Overweights a later superficial detail instead of retaining or appropriately updating the original boundary evidence.

chains.frame: Which term best describes Lena’s comparison in the budget lesson?

beats.text: Lena explained a household budget using a bucket: income pours in while bills drain it.
beats.decisive_clue: matched parts of a bucket to stages of managing money
beats.reason: The comparison explains how a budget functions.

beats.text: She compared savings with the water remaining after the outflow.
beats.decisive_clue: continued mapping the parallel to clarify savings
beats.reason: The additional correspondence makes the explanatory parallel more complete.

chains.feedback_short: Continued mapping the parallel to clarify savings; the additional correspondence makes the explanatory parallel more complete.
chains.feedback_deep: Analogy means comparison explains a relationship through a shared structure; metaphor means figurative description calls one thing another. The additional correspondence makes the explanatory parallel more complete.
chains.contrast_rule: An analogy compares how two different things work to explain an idea; a metaphor describes one thing as another to create meaning or an image.

chains.frame: Which term best describes Carlos’s description of patience?

beats.text: Carlos wrote, “Her patience was a cracked cup,” after describing another argument.
beats.decisive_clue: direct figurative identification of patience with an object
beats.reason: The expression makes an image by equating unlike things.

beats.text: He kept that short image without explaining a detailed correspondence between cups and feelings.
beats.decisive_clue: the image stands without an explanatory mapping
beats.reason: The lack of an extended parallel reinforces its figurative purpose.
